traditional: A hard contact. Action, conflict, and heat works against limitation, delay, and hard structure - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas. Two malefics in a hard aspect: handle with care, and worse when either is out of sect.
modern: Drive meets limit. Disciplined endurance and the ability to pace yourself and keep going long after others quit. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Gas and brake at once: jerky, stop-start progress, frustration, and a need to avoid burning bridges in case of retreat. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Drive and limit reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Endurance and discipline; the friction is the constant start-stop of push against restraint.
shadow: Anger and recklessness collides with fear and rigidity; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.

readerCopy.body: Every restriction feels like a personal attack when you are already burning with the desire to move forward. When Mars opposes Saturn, urgency crashes into boundaries, turning necessary guardrails into infuriating roadblocks. Some limits are protecting your long-term stability, while others are just bureaucratic noise. Figure out which one you are dealing with before you start tearing down walls you will need tomorrow.
